rationale.conceptual: Non-trivial implementation of custom basis sets (even-tempered diffuse, polarization) and application of specific DFT functional (BHLYP) on a series of molecules, requiring careful handling of basis set data and quantum chemistry software. However, the underlying theory is established DFT; no novel algorithms are needed.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline: (1) generate DZP++ basis sets from paper specifications, (2) set up and run 30 unrestricted DFT opt/freq calculations across three states per molecule, (3) extract energies and compute four electron affinity measures plus singlet-triplet gaps. Involves multiple steps with potential need for scripting and parsing output files, but not an extremely long or fragile workflow.
